item.text:
The bubbles are on main and pushed. Your dev server picks it up live, so just look at any thread.
- **Your messages:** a solid accent bubble.
- **Messages relayed from another agent:** the tinted bubble.
- **Selecting text inside your bubble:** full invert, meaning accent-coloured text on a solid band of the bubble's text colour. The selection style everywhere else is unchanged.
- **Inside your bubble, also adjusted:** "Show full message", non-image attachment names and the image focus ring all use the bubble's text colour, so they stay visible on solid accent.

The gate passes. I haven't screenshotted it myself, so tell me if anything looks off.

One thing to watch: with "Match accent to wallpaper" on, the accent comes from your wallpaper. The bubble text stays near-white in light mode and near-black in dark, so an unusually light or dark wallpaper accent could make text in your bubbles harder to read. Fine with the presets, but worth a glance with your wallpaper on.
